_comment: Ground truth from Factorio 2.1.23 (build 87750, linux64, headless) via factorio-oracle, map seed 123456, DERIVED surface seeds (Nauvis 123456, Vulcanus 1249936247, Fulgora 2967702466), with the terrain-only data-final-fixes mod and each planet's PNG controls at size 0, read back off every surface. Asks whether the --generate-map-preview PNG shows the tile get_tile reports after full generation (arm A, 'filled') or the raw argmax of the game's own tile scores (calculate_tile_properties 'tile:<name>:probability', the POINT noise kernel; cross-checked equal at every value to a data-stage copy of each probability_expression). blocks: per 96x96 block, tiles where filled and raw agree (and how many the PNG matches - the apparatus control), and every tile where they differ as a differColumns row, binned by margin (raw score minus the filled tile's score, 'large' >= 0.001), with which reading the PNG pixel shows. Fulgora blocks are the correction control. targets: the two Task 1 pixels in full, with arm B ('isolated': one chunk generated alone, in a separate run) and the chunk census around it.
